test_instructions: Launch the validated fork local checkout's x64\Debug\PowerToys.exe.
Enable or sideload the CmdPal JavaScript/TypeScript sample extension and open its Samples provider.
Navigate away from and back to the Samples index, then reopen OnLoad, comments, and settings samples; verify their state and lifecycle history are retained across index refreshes.

Load an extension manifest with a valid contained icon, an absolute or escaping path, and a missing or reparse-point path; verify valid icons resolve and rejected paths produce no icon rather than loading an external file.
